POSEIDONANCIENT-POSEIDON_ANCIENT.title: Poseidon
POSEIDONANCIENT-POSEIDON_ANCIENT.talk.AN: My winsome niece, it is I! And I bring bounties to you from the seas themselves!
The greatest acts of vengeance don't come easily, my niece! So take heart, and also this!
That blasted Titan thinks he's got us, but we'll show him he's all wet, won't we, my niece?
Remind that good-for-nothing Titan that Olympus is in charge, would you, my niece?
Look, we could use all the help we can get. And we can't be choosy when there's none-too-many fish in the sea!
I owe your father for his generosity. But since he's gone, I'll pay you back instead!
Go show those Titans who's in charge, all right? If you catch my meaning, hahahaha!
The seas aren't going anywhere, and neither are we, right, my niece?
Hoh, my little niece, your greatest uncle's here! Here to make sure you really make a splash!
A storm is brewing, Niece. Big one, this time, why, even bigger than the last! Prepare!
Flow forth, my niece, and overwhelm all those who stand against us, would you there?
My waves can slam into the land with massive force, especially when I give them a little push!
We're in the middle of a war here, little Hades, so we'll chitchat later! Now, we fight!
All right, Niece, I've little patience left to spare right now, but that's good news for you!
You're here upon my surface, aren't you? Why, welcome back, and pardon all the mess!
Come on, Niece, let's go batter down our enemies like ships within a storm!
The tides are turning, can't you feel it, Niece? I can, of course, but surely you can, too!
High tide has come again, my niece! Which is my little way of saying, here we go!
No holding back this time, you hear me down there, Niece! Now let's get shaking!
You have the power of the seas right at your beck and call!
The untold bounties of the sea are yours! Well, one of them, at least!
If only your father could see you now! Fortunately, I still sort of can!
The strength of earth and sea is yours again, if you can handle it, my niece!
I'll never stop fighting for you! Not until the fighting stops! Perhaps not even then!
You remind me of crusty old Hades more and more! In a good way!
One sudden surge of awesome might, coming right up!
Arise, my niece! As would a fierce sea-creature of some sort! One blessed by me!
Nothing beats doling out terrible consequences to our enemies, now, does it, Niece?
Many great battles have been fought upon my seas, but they'll all pale in comparison to this!
Come, Niece, let us crash upon our enemies as great waves upon a shore!
Even the mortals know the sea is bountiful, yet also capable of deadly force!
POSEIDONANCIENT-POSEIDON_ANCIENT.talk.fi: My long-lost niece, you live! We thought you met the same fate as your father! And your mother, and your brother, augh! Well how about we turn the tide, and exact terrible revenge for poor old Hades and his kin?!
